title: Why Australia Struggles to Foster Asia Experts
gist: An Australian government inquiry, "Security and Prosperity in Asia: Building Asia Capability in Australia through the Education System and Beyond," concludes that Australia's prosperity, diplomacy and strategic independence increasingly depend on regional knowledge, while the institutions meant to build that capability are weakening.
